name: Marothu Harsha Vardhan
tagline: Building a body of work, one frame at a time.
statement: I am at the beginning of the road, and that is exactly the point. Every short, every frame, every late night on set is a sentence in a longer story I am still learning how to tell. This page is where that story gets written down as it happens.
bio: Marothu Harsha Vardhan is an emerging director whose work is driven by character, silence, and the things people don't say out loud. He is currently developing his first slate of independent projects.
